operative_context: Loyalty points are awarded only when rent status is Completed and payment status is Paid
exceptions: Loyalty points are assigned only when both rent status is Completed AND payment status is Paid (dual condition)
Loyalty redemption cannot occur after invoice payment is completed
conflicts_or_obsolete: Early cancellation penalty exemption mentioned in JIRA-Lifecycle.md may have been removed or is missing from current documentation, creating uncertainty about whether it applies to loyalty eligibility
notes: TARGET_ID R93c addresses 'Loyalty eligibility condition rule' but the provided evidence focuses on loyalty points accrual, redemption, and tier management rather than explicit eligibility conditions. E8 and E9 are the most directly relevant sources. E1-E7 provide rent lifecycle and availability context that may inform eligibility but do not directly specify loyalty eligibility rules. The primary evidence (E1) is about rent lifecycle validation and does not address loyalty.
